sample_unit: clinical cases across modalities and datasets

links.outcome: Model performance on held-out datasets from different clinical sites (MIMIC-IV, JHU PMAP)
links.effect: The model trained on public clinical data only generalized to both the held-out MIMIC-IV and the private JHU PMAP dataset collected at Johns Hopkins University hospital.
links.quote: The model trained on public clinical data only generalized to both the held-out MIMIC-IV and the private JHU PMAP dataset collected at Johns Hopkins University hospital.

screen.reason: Evaluates new multimodal reasoning foundation models (QoQ-Med3) across multiple clinical tasks, modalities, and cross-site datasets (including hallucination analysis), but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
